defect: Cobros visually renders inferred installments 1-4 as Conciliado in Estado/Conciliación/acción, collapsing inferred provenance into reconciliation.
Receipt detail hero can render an inferred payment as Cobro conciliado although paidDate remains unknown and inferredEffectiveDate is present.

remediationContract: PAID_INFERRED/directOrInferred=INFERRED must remain visibly identified as Pago inferido.
Reconciliation must render as a separate dimension and must not replace payment provenance.
Actual paidDate remains No informada when no direct evidence exists.
Evidence/source and inference provenance remain available in receipt detail.
Direct anchor payment remains distinguishable from inferred prior installments.

performanceDisposition.observation: Human timing approximately 6s receipt detail and 4s Cobros list.
performanceDisposition.rationale: The demonstrated defect is label/read-model precedence; no new fetch, hydration or KPI calculation is required by the remediation.

kpiDisposition.evidence: Human captures show portfolio/KPI totals that do not reconcile with visible paid/inferred installments.
